headline: South Africa Poultry Strike Expands to Festive Chicken Plant in Krugersdorp
summary: Labor strikes over wage demands of R13,500 per month expanded to Festive Chicken operations in Krugersdorp, threatening poultry supply chains ahead of the holiday season.
why: South Africa's poultry sector is a vital component of the nation's food security and agricultural manufacturing labor force.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Expanded industrial action restricts poultry production and threatens regional supply chains.
